title: smartshortcuts
description: Smart chat shortcuts for your server. Easily share your position (%pos), held item (%item), and experience level (%exp) in messages.
body:
**SmartShortcuts is a lightweight and modern Paper/Spigot plugin that allows players to quickly share their status, location, and items in chat using simple placeholders.
Features**

-     %pos — Shares your current coordinates (X,Y,Z).
-     %item — Showcases the item you are currently holding.
-     %exp — Displays your current experience level.

    Private Messages Support — Shortcuts work in /msg, /tell, and /m commands.

    Performance Optimized — Built with the modern Adventure API and includes an automatic cache cleanup system to keep your server fast.

    
```
    Installation
    Download the .jar file.
    Drop it into your server's /plugins folder.
    Restart your server.
    Requirement: Requires Java 21 and Paper/Purpur 1.21+.
```
